name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tooltip as a mini speech bubble with a curved tail (or two circles for thought) that follows the side; the offset leaves room for the tail. TooltipBubble renders a static bubble for previews and docs.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip". It wraps your own components/ui/tooltip, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A tiny speech or thought bubble.
meta.usage:
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip"

<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger>Hover me</TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent variant="thought">Maybe tomorrow.</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>
